% A test for tex8web's chapters and parts under titlesec: a chapter's
% \titleformat, in a font, size and alignment of its own, with its
% \titlespacing, and a part in report's format.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\chapter}[display]{\normalfont\sffamily\huge\filcenter}
    {\chaptertitlename\ \thechapter}{12pt}{}
\titlespacing*{\chapter}{0pt}{20pt}{30pt}
\begin{document}
\part{Beginnings}
\chapter{First}
Some text.
\section{A section}
More text.
\end{document}
